PAM connection settings as JSON string. Structure varies by protocol:
- RDP: protocol, port, recordingIncludeKeys, security, ignoreCert, resizeMethod, enableFullWindowDrag, enableWallpaper, sftp

- SSH: protocol, port, recordingIncludeKeys, colorScheme, allowSupplyUser, hostKey, command, fontSize, sftp
- Database: protocol, port, recordingIncludeKeys, allowSupplyUser, database, allowSupplyHost
All protocols support portForward sub-object with port and reusePort fields.
